Join a Challenger
At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. 

We can’t wait to get to know you! 


The Work
 
The Director, Change Enablement advances EQ Bank’s enterprise Change Enablement practice, a standing capability within People & Talent accountable for readiness, adoption and sustained behaviour change across the Bank’s concurrent transformation agenda. The role closes the gap between funded transformation delivery and the employee readiness required to realize value across enterprise AI, PC Financial integration and convergence, and the EQB 2.0 operating model. Reporting to the Vice President, Talent, Transformation & Design, the incumbent owns the enterprise change method, demand prioritization, adoption readiness and executive-level visibility of change saturation. The mandate is to identify, plan, sequence and land change with the business, making adoption an engineered outcome rather than a communications task applied at go-live.  

The Core Responsibilities: Enterprise Change Enablement Strategy 
 Establish and maintain the enterprise Change Enablement practice within People & Talent, including standards, methods, tools, intake, demand prioritization and governance routines. 
 Own a tiered support model that sizes change enablement effort based on employee impact, adoption risk, complexity and strategic importance. 
 Maintain enterprise visibility of change saturation across major transformation programs and provide clear recommendations on sequencing, readiness and trade-offs. 
 Partner with program sponsors, business leaders, Enterprise AI, IMO, Convergence, EQB 2.0, Organization Design, Communications, Risk and Finance to ensure change, structure, process and value-realization plans are aligned. 
 Position adoption as a measurable business outcome by defining readiness criteria, adoption measures, sustainment practices and post-implementation review requirements. 
 Adoption, Readiness and Leader Enablement 
 Lead change impact assessments, stakeholder mapping, readiness assessments, resistance sensing and adoption planning for high-impact enterprise initiatives. 
 Design leader and manager enablement approaches that equip people leaders to communicate change with clarity, handle difficult questions and reinforce desired behaviours. 
 Create and maintain reusable change playbooks, templates, communications inputs, training supports and adoption measurement practices that can be scaled across initiatives. 
 Use employee feedback, pulse checks, readiness data, service data and adoption telemetry to identify friction early and adjust enablement plans. 
 Ensure change enablement aligns with EQB’s culture refresh, ways of working and employee experience commitments so transformation lands in a credible and consistent way. 
 Portfolio, Measurement and Executive Reporting 
 Maintain a consolidated enterprise change calendar across AI, integration, convergence and operating model initiatives to identify collisions, capacity pressure and sequencing risks. 
 Provide executive-level reporting on change saturation, readiness at go-live, adoption velocity, friction after go-live and time to value. 
 Translate readiness and adoption data into clear recommendations for senior leaders, including where to accelerate, pause, sequence differently or add support. 
 Partner with Finance value tracking teams to connect adoption and readiness to benefit realization, while maintaining clear accountability boundaries. 
 Partner with Risk, Compliance and control functions to ensure change plans meet regulatory expectations and produce evidence of readiness, adoption and sustainment where required. 
 Practice Governance and Flexible Capacity 
 Provide practice guidance, standards and coaching to partners applying change enablement methods across enterprise initiatives. 
 Build and manage a pre-qualified contractor pool to provide flexible capacity for large waves, peak demand, training build, communications production and adoption measurement. 
 Manage the Change Enablement operating budget, including contractor spend, and make pragmatic resourcing trade-offs across competing program demands. 
 Contribute to the broader People & Talent strategy and assess workforce upskilling and training needs arising from automation, role redesign and new ways of working.
Let's Talk About You: Post-secondary education in Business, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Organizational Development or a related field; graduate degree is an asset. 
 10+ years of total work experience, including at least seven years leading organizational change on enterprise-scale transformation, technology, AI, automation, operating model or integration programs. 
 Experience coordinating cross-functional contributors and external or contingent resources in a matrixed environment. 
 Experience in financial services, another regulated industry or management consulting is preferred. 
 Expert knowledge of change management methods and demonstrated ability to establish a practice where none exists; Prosci, CCMP or equivalent certification is preferred. 
 Demonstrated experience building impact assessments, readiness plans, stakeholder maps, leader enablement approaches, adoption measures and sustainment plans. 
 Working knowledge of organization design, workforce planning, learning design and internal communications sufficient to partner effectively with those practices without duplicating accountabilities. 
 Strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret adoption telemetry, readiness data, engagement feedback and operational signals and translate findings into executive recommendations. 
 Exceptional written, verbal and facilitation skills, including the ability to influence executives, prepare briefing materials, lead senior workshops and shape enterprise-wide messaging during uncertainty. 
 Strong judgement, resilience and credibility with senior leaders, including the ability to hold a view on sequencing, saturation and adoption risk when sponsors want to move faster. 
 Pragmatic self-starter who can operate strategically while also building templates, running workshops, writing briefing notes and solving practical implementation issues.

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


Role overview:

Code-generating LLMs and autonomous agents are revolutionizing how software is built and tasks are automated. At Cohere, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with these technologies for enterprises, and we’re looking for a senior member for the Agent Code team. You’ll be at the forefront of research and engineering, driving the development of cutting-edge code LLMs and agent systems that can interact with the digital world to solve complex tasks with minimal human oversight.



This role is hands-on and research-driven. You’ll dive into the latest literature on code LLMs and agents, experiment with frontier models, and collaborate with a team of talented engineers and researchers to build scalable, production-ready solutions. At Cohere, we blend engineering and research seamlessly—everyone contributes to both, depending on their interests and organizational needs. We provide access to world-class compute resources, data, and talent to ensure you can do your best work.



Note: We have offices in London, Toronto, New York and San Francisco, but we’re also remote-friendly! This team operates primarily between ET to CET time zones, so we’re seeking candidates in locations that align with these hours for effective collaboration.



Key responsibilities:

 - Stay up-to-date with the latest research in code LLMs, agents, and related fields, implementing novel ideas into our systems.

 - Design and implement scalable strategies to train code models, and deploy agent frameworks for inference and sampling. You will be collaborating with the pretraining team, create SFT trajectories and work on existing and new RL algorithms

 - Hillclimb on existing benchmarks and design new ones that reflect the needs of our enterprise users

 - Lead experiments on our state-of-the-art compute infrastructure, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with frontier LLMs.



Qualifications:

 - A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, with publications in top-tier venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP).

 - Deep expertise in code LLMs and agent systems, with a strong understanding of the latest research and trends. We are looking for people who not only have worked with code models, but have actively contributed to their development

 - Hands-on experience with frontier LLMs and their applications in code generation or automation.

 - Strong software engineering skills, with proficiency in Python and PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks.

 - Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and scalable architectures.

 - A proactive, self-motivated mindset, with a passion for solving ambitious, open-ended problems.



Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners.
 We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor.
 The mission of this role
 Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer.
 Who are we?
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.
 What is our culture like & who is a good fit?
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:
 Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.
 Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day.
 Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts.
 Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told.
 If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. 
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.
 Outcomes (what success looks like)
 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.
 Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
 Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)
 Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped
 AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell)
 No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day
 Key Objectives
 Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first.
 Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells.
 Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners.
 Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor.
 Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix.
 Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house.
 Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting.

 Fluent in English

As part of a growing, dynamic & solution-focused commercial team, the Commercial Mortgage Underwriter is responsible for underwriting conventional commercial mortgages.  The underwriter must adhere to established policies and underwriting standards, meeting compliance and control requirements, while finding creative and service-oriented solutions in a timely manner in order to achieve department goals as well as annual target volumes. Additional credit-related and administrative duties are also required such as reporting and pipeline management. Il est également responsable de s’assurer que toutes les conditions de financement sont respectées et que la documentation requise est complétée dans les délais.
 30 % du temps : Le titulaire assure une coordination étroite avec les intervenants internes (équipes de financement, gestionnaires, administrateurs, équipes de ventes commerciales) ainsi qu’externes (partenaires prêteurs, courtiers hypothécaires, clients, notaires, évaluateurs et consultants) afin de garantir un traitement efficace et rapide des dossiers, dans le respect des échéanciers de financement et des standards de service. Des visites de propriétés ou inspections sommaires peuvent être requises selon les dossiers.
 15 % du temps : Le titulaire gère activement son pipeline de dossiers, en assurant un suivi rigoureux et une gestion efficace des priorités afin de respecter les délais établis.
 5 % du temps : Le titulaire est responsable de certaines tâches administratives et de production de rapports mensuels pour le département et l’organisation, lesquels sont utilisés par la haute direction pour le suivi des activités.

 50% on a daily basis, the incumbent will analyze and underwrite commercial credit facilities together with additional credit related and administrative duties, for conventional commercial mortgage product types. The incumbent is responsible to ensure all lending criteria have been satisfied on deals underwritten and outstanding documentation/conditions, if any, are being met in a timely manner.

 Job Complexities

 Le poste s’exerce dans un environnement de bureau standard, sans exigences physiques particulières. Toutefois, il peut comporter un certain niveau de pression en raison des délais serrés associés aux transactions et du volume élevé de dossiers à traiter.

 The incumbent will communicate daily with management, staff within the department and company, as well as external contacts (clients, mortgage brokers, Lending Partners, etc.).

 Normal office environment with no physical demands; however there is substantial pressure, at times, placed on the incumbent due to the time sensitivity of each transaction and the level of volume faced daily. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Automations Platform to be part of our AI Workflows product organization.



The team:

The Automations Platform team builds the system that lets Jobber Teammate, our AI teammate for home service businesses, do a service provider's work for them. Every automation in Jobber runs on what this team builds.



The role:

You'll make it possible for Jobber Teammate to automate every task in Jobber.

Today a handful of automations exist and each one is expensive to build. The ambition is that every task a service provider repeats in their week has an automation that does it for them. Getting there takes two things at once, and this role does both.

You'll build the platform: the authoring, execution and evaluation models that let any product team at Jobber ship an automation without first becoming AI specialists. Skill files, tool calls, and evals that make an automation measurably better over time.

You'll also build on the platform: choosing the automations that matter most, shipping them yourself, and making them easy to find, enable and trust. Being the platform's hardest customer is what keeps it honest.

Over time you'll open it up, so service providers create their own and the best ones spread to businesses like theirs.

This suits someone equally at home in an architecture discussion and a customer interview.



As Senior Product Manager you will:

 - Build a deep understanding of home service businesses and the repeated work that consumes their week.

 - Own the automation platform: how automations are authored, how they execute, and how they're evaluated and improved.

 - Make it fast and cheap for any Jobber team to ship an automation, and measure yourself on their throughput rather than your own.

 - Build the highest-impact automations yourself, and make them easy for service providers to find, enable and trust.

 - Build an Evals platform, that makes it easy to iterate on and improve automations so the quality bar is constantly raising
